remarks: Welcome to 5 Park Avenue in charming Old Greenwich, CT! This newly listed, spacious rental has 5 bedrooms and 2.1 bathrooms, spread over a generous 2,990 square feet. Freshly painted and featuring new hardwood floors throughout, this home is move in ready. The property sits on a 10,019 square foot lot and includes an in law suite above the garage. A perfect retreat for guests or additional living space. Three garages that can fit up to four cars. Situated in a prime location, conveniently close to town, restaurants, the beach and the train. This home is a true gem and won't last long on the market. Don't miss your chance to experience the best of Old Greenwich living!
